turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until twenty to five, so let's not waste it. Who entered that zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
You're welcome. Now answer me, Hale. That zero went into the gradebook, and I'd like to know on whose decision.
I have to say, I can tell you're an amazing mother. Owen is lucky to have someone fight for him like this.
Don't manage me. Who decided, Hale?
Honestly, I wish more parents cared as much as you do.
Then why are we here? That's three times you haven't answered me, and I'm writing that down. One more compliment and I'm finishing this conversation in the principal's office.
So I'm sure we can work this out together.
"Together." You entered a mark against my son without calling me, and now it's together. The zero comes off, Hale, or I'm going upstairs.
